channel.title: Veritane News: official disaster alerts
channel.description: Official alerts at the two highest levels from GDACS and the U.S. Geological Survey, as shown on the Veritane world news map. Each item links to the event tracker or the publisher’s page.

item.title: India: Tropical cyclone Murasu · GDACS alert level: Red
item.description: GDACS alert level: Red. 157 km/h. Since: 2026-11-01. Source page: https://www.gdacs.org/report.aspx?eventtype=TC&eventid=1001346. GDACS alerts for earthquakes, tsunamis and tropical cyclones are automatic estimates from models and can contain errors. They do not replace warnings from national authorities.
